meta.title: Sampan: stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash
meta.description: Swap BCH and PUSD, land BCH as PUSD, and move USDC in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
banner.note: New project. First commit after the 14 November start. Planning notes are in /preparation.
hero.title: Stablecoins in and out of Bitcoin Cash.
hero.sub.near-intents: One signature each way. No BCH needed for fees. Send from any wallet or exchange, or connect yours. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.sub.thorchain: USDC and USDT arrive as PUSD in your BCH wallet. PUSD leaves as USDC or USDT. No BCH needed for fees. Sampan never holds your coins.
hero.honest: On Bitcoin Cash every step is a transaction you sign, or a contract that can only pay you. The crossing between chains is carried by {route}.
